```yaml
name: Publish Skills to ClawHub

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Re-publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        run: |
          pip install clawhub

      - name: Authenticate with ClawHub
        run: |
          clawhub login --token ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Determine changed skills
        id: changed_skills
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" && "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "publish_all=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "changed_skills=*" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            # Get list of changed skill files
            git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E '\.skills/' | sed 's|\.skills/||' | sed 's|/.*||' | sort -u > /tmp/changed_skills.txt
            if [[ -s /tmp/changed_skills.txt ]]; then
              CHANGED_SKILLS=$(cat /tmp/changed_skills.txt | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
              echo "changed_skills=${CHANGED_SKILLS}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
              echo "publish_all=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            else
              echo "changed_skills=" >> $GITHUB_ENV
              echo "publish_all=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            fi
          fi

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: env.changed_skills != ''
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ env.publish_all }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Publishing all skills..."
            find .skills -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | while read skill_file; do
              skill_name=$(basename "$skill_file" .yaml | basename "$skill_file" .yml)
              echo "Publishing $skill_name..."
              clawhub publish "$skill_file" --accept-license-terms
            done
          else
            IFS=',' read -ra SKILLS <<< "${{ env.changed_skills }}"
            for skill in "${SKILLS[@]}"; do
              skill_file=".skills/${skill}.yaml"
              if [[ -f "$skill_file" ]]; then
                echo "Publishing $skill..."
                clawhub publish "$skill_file" --accept-license-terms
              else
                skill_file=".skills/${skill}.yml"
                if [[ -f "$skill_file" ]]; then
                  echo "Publishing $skill..."
                  clawhub publish "$skill_file" --accept-license-terms
                fi
              fi
            done
          fi
```
